content.text:
Start with a "goodbye hug" at bedtime: sit with Milo until he's drowsy, then move to a chair nearby, shifting it a little further toward the door each night until you're out. At 5, he's ready for this gradual exit — most kids take one to two weeks to settle fully solo.

Want the full night-by-night plan for moving Milo to his own bed? Reply YES and I'll send it.
